kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source's two paragraphs.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the two definitional paragraphs; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The three-anchor reading of any 'ACh receptor' stem (ANCHOR 1 — SORT THE FAMILY: nicotinic = ligand-gated channel (ionotropic, ms-fast, ACh binding IS pore opening); muscarinic = G-protein–coupled receptor (metabotropic, second messenger). ANCHOR 2 — IF NICOTINIC, READ THE SUBSCRIPT: the second letter names the station — N-N = neuron→neuron, the ganglionic synapses (autonomic ganglia of BOTH divisions + the adrenal medulla); N-M = neuron→muscle, the neuromuscular junction of skeletal muscle. ANCHOR 3 — IF MUSCARINIC, APPLY THE ODD/EVEN G-PROTEIN RULE: odd-numbered subtypes (M1, M3, M5) → Gq → PLC → IP3 + DAG; even-numbered (M2, M4) → Gi → ↓ adenylyl cyclase → ↓cAMP) — KYP's synthesis of the section's two sentences plus the book-237 table into one reading order (family → station → G protein).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the two definitions side by side without a reading protocol; the family→station→G-protein order, the neuron→neuron / neuron→muscle subscript reading, and the odd/even rule are KYP's design (the M1/M2/M3 G-protein letters themselves are the book's own, from book 237).
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms + the visual's reading-rule strip

kypExtensions.summary: The M1–M5 mechanism layer (M1 = Gq → IP3/DAG — brain: higher cognitive functions, enteric nervous system, exocrine gland secretions; M2 = Gi → ↓cAMP — heart: ↓ heart rate, ↓ AV node conduction velocity, ↓ atrial contractility; M3 = Gq → IP3/DAG — exocrine glands, gut peristalsis, bladder contraction, bronchoconstriction, vasodilation, miosis, accommodation; M4 = Gi → ↓cAMP — beyond the book's printed set; M5 = Gq → IP3/DAG — beyond the book's printed set). kypExtensions.rationale: The source page names the five subtypes and their collective locations but prints no per-subtype mechanism; the assembled mechanism map (with its provenance split: book-anchored M1–M3 vs KYP-extended M4/M5) is KYP's synthesis.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP-original mnemonics (1 — ONE TRANSMITTER, TWO ALPHABETS: nicotinic channels (NN/NM) at the switches and the muscle; muscarinic GPCRs (M1–M5) at the organs. 2 — N-N = NEURON→NEURON, N-M = NEURON→MUSCLE: the subscript names the station — NN at autonomic ganglia + the adrenal medulla, NM at the neuromuscular junction of skeletal muscle. 3 — ODD IS Gq, EVEN IS Gi: M1/M3/M5 → PLC → IP3 + DAG; M2/M4 → ↓cAMP (the M1–M3 letters anchored to the book's book-237 table; the rule itself KYP). 4 — SWEAT IS ON THE LIST: the book's own location list ends 'and on sweat glands (cholinergic sympathetic)' — the sympathetic exception is muscarinic M₃). The Acetylcholine receptors section prints NO margin mnemonic — all four codes are KYP-original designs.
